printed: AVE (diagonal, name not printed in region)
AVENUE (vertical, name not printed in region)
note: A diagonal avenue comes in from the SW, carries car tracks and joins a near-vertical avenue (lots 3215-3236; Richard Woolley's Homestead to the east) at a Y. North of the junction one road runs on to Hewitt at y~160, where a branch marked 'MONT.' leaves to the NE. Neither avenue's name is printed inside the region, so which is Gilbert and which is Woodburn is inferred, not read. The plate is cut along the diagonal's NW side and along the vertical avenue's west side. The point is where the diagonal's centreline/track merges into the vertical avenue's centreline.

printed: AVE (diagonal from SW, name not printed in region; presumably Gilbert)
note: WOODBURN (lots 3301-3315) runs N-S. A short southern stub of it (x 8650-8740) is cut by the plate edge. The diagonal 'AVE' comes from the SW (lots 3251-3267) and carries tracks NE into MONTGOMERY. Woodburn, the diagonal and Montgomery all meet at one point. The diagonal's SE side lies beyond the plate edge, so its centreline is estimated from the NW curb and the track.

note: A curving 'ST.' runs ESE to a NNE-running 'AVENUE' with car tracks. Gilbert's east side is also at the plate edge, so its centre is taken from the track. A stub leaves the avenue's east side about 150 px further north (y 2180-2295), possibly a continuation. printed: AVE. (name not printed in region; lots 862-876)
note: GILBERT runs NE, turns SSW at the Walters Avenue junction (4000,6870) and runs to the region's bottom edge. A long curving street labelled only 'AVE.' comes from the west and meets Gilbert near the bottom. Its south side and the SW corner are cut by the plate edge. Its shape (bend at the west end, ESE run of about 950 px) matches the 'ST.' on 22-66, but here the suffix printed is 'AVE.' and the name 'Wehrman' is not printed, so the identity is uncertain. Other streets meeting Gilbert here are WALTERS AVE (from the north at 4000,6870) and an 'SP...' stub to the south at about (4430,6730).
